method: WebFetch of each course page on www.bristol.ac.uk (2027 entry pages; re-fetched with cache-busting query strings — MEng Mechanical Engineering and MEng Civil Engineering first returned a stale copy quoting 2026-entry fees and "Fees for 2027 will be confirmed", which the fresh copy no longer shows). Bristol fees-funding page also checked.

universityWideStatements.title: Fees and funding | Study at Bristol | University of Bristol
universityWideStatements.appliesTo: UK (Home) undergraduate tuition fee for 2027/28; also consistent with each course page. Not used as scopeless fee: each course page states the figure itself.

universityWideStatements.quote: International fees are reviewed annually and will generally increase by inflation each year of study, capped at a maximum of 8%.
